name: Message function code
description: Code indicating the function of the message.

values.name: Cancellation
values.description: Cancellation Message cancelling a previous transmission for a given transaction.

values.name: Addition
values.description: Addition Message containing items to be added.

values.name: Deletion
values.description: Deletion Message containing items to be deleted.

values.name: Change
values.description: Change Message containing items to be changed.

values.name: Replace
values.description: Replace Message replacing a previous message.

values.name: Confirmation
values.description: Confirmation Message confirming the details of a previous transmission where such confirmation is required or recommended under the terms of a trading partner agreement.

values.name: Duplicate
values.description: Duplicate The message is a duplicate of a previously generated message.

values.name: Status
values.description: Status Code indicating that the referenced message is a status.

values.name: Original
values.description: Original Initial transmission related to a given transaction.

values.name: Not found
values.description: Not found Message whose reference number is not filed.

values.name: Response
values.description: Response Message responding to a previous message or document.

values.name: Not processed
values.description: Not processed Message indicating that the referenced message was received but not yet processed.

values.name: Request
values.description: Request Code indicating that the referenced message is a request.

values.name: Advance notification
values.description: Advance notification Code indicating that the information contained in the message is an advance notification of information to follow.

values.name: Reminder
values.description: Reminder Repeated message transmission for reminding purposes.

values.name: Proposal
values.description: Proposal Message content is a proposal.

values.name: Cancel, to be reissued
values.description: Cancel, to be reissued Referenced transaction cancelled, reissued message will follow.

values.name: Reissue
values.description: Reissue New issue of a previous message (maybe cancelled).

values.name: Seller initiated change
values.description: Seller initiated change Change information submitted by buyer but initiated by seller.

values.name: Replace heading section only
values.description: Replace heading section only Message to replace the heading of a previous message.

values.name: Replace item detail and summary only
values.description: Replace item detail and summary only Message to replace item detail and summary of a previous message.

values.name: Final transmission
values.description: Final transmission Final message in a related series of messages together making up a commercial, administrative or transport transaction.

values.name: Transaction on hold
values.description: Transaction on hold Message not to be processed until further release information.

values.name: Delivery instruction
values.description: Delivery instruction Delivery schedule message only used to transmit short- term delivery instructions.

values.name: Forecast
values.description: Forecast Delivery schedule message only used to transmit long- term schedule information.

values.name: Delivery instruction and forecast
values.description: Delivery instruction and forecast Combination of codes '24' and '25'.

values.name: Not accepted
values.description: Not accepted Message to inform that the referenced message is not accepted by the recipient.

values.name: Accepted, with amendment in heading section
values.description: Accepted, with amendment in heading section Message accepted but amended in heading section.

values.name: Accepted without amendment
values.description: Accepted without amendment Referenced message is entirely accepted.

values.name: Accepted, with amendment in detail section
values.description: Accepted, with amendment in detail section Referenced message is accepted but amended in detail section.

values.name: Copy
values.description: Copy Indicates that the message is a copy of an original message that has been sent, e.g. for action or information.

values.name: Approval
values.description: Approval A message releasing an existing referenced message for action to the receiver.

values.name: Change in heading section
values.description: Change in heading section Message changing the referenced message heading section.

values.name: Accepted with amendment
values.description: Accepted with amendment The referenced message is accepted but amended.

values.name: Retransmission
values.description: Retransmission Change-free transmission of a message previously sent.

values.name: Change in detail section
values.description: Change in detail section Message changing referenced detail section.

values.name: Reversal of a debit
values.description: Reversal of a debit Reversal of a previously posted debit.

values.name: Reversal of a credit
values.description: Reversal of a credit Reversal of a previously posted credit.

values.name: Reversal for cancellation
values.description: Reversal for cancellation Code indicating that the referenced message is reversing a cancellation of a previous transmission for a given transaction.

values.name: Request for deletion
values.description: Request for deletion The message is given to inform the recipient to delete the referenced transaction.

values.name: Finishing/closing order
values.description: Finishing/closing order Last of series of call-offs.

values.name: Confirmation via specific means
values.description: Confirmation via specific means Message confirming a transaction previously agreed via other means (e.g. phone).

values.name: Additional transmission
values.description: Additional transmission Message already transmitted via another communication channel. This transmission is to provide electronically processable data only.

values.name: Accepted without reserves
values.description: Accepted without reserves Message accepted without reserves.

values.name: Accepted with reserves
values.description: Accepted with reserves Message accepted with reserves.

values.name: Provisional
values.description: Provisional Message content is provisional.

values.name: Definitive
values.description: Definitive Message content is definitive.

values.name: Accepted, contents rejected
values.description: Accepted, contents rejected Message to inform that the previous message is received, but it cannot be processed due to regulations, laws, etc.

values.name: Settled dispute
values.description: Settled dispute The reported dispute is settled.

values.name: Withdraw
values.description: Withdraw Message withdrawing a previously approved message.

values.name: Authorisation
values.description: Authorisation Message authorising a message or transaction(s).

values.name: Proposed amendment
values.description: Proposed amendment A code used to indicate an amendment suggested by the sender.

values.name: Test
values.description: Test Code indicating the message is to be considered as a test.

values.name: Extract
values.description: Extract A subset of the original.

values.name: Notification only
values.description: Notification only The receiver may use the notification information for analysis only.

values.name: Advice of ledger booked items
values.description: Advice of ledger booked items An advice that items have been booked in the ledger.

values.name: Advice of items pending to be booked in the ledger
values.description: Advice of items pending to be booked in the ledger An advice that items are pending to be booked in the ledger.

values.name: Pre-advice of items requiring further information
values.description: Pre-advice of items requiring further information A pre-advice that items require further information.

values.name: Pre-adviced items
values.description: Pre-adviced items A pre-advice of items.

values.name: No action since last message
values.description: No action since last message Code indicating the fact that no action has taken place since the last message.

values.name: Complete schedule
values.description: Complete schedule The message function is a complete schedule.

values.name: Update schedule
values.description: Update schedule The message function is an update to a schedule.

values.name: Not accepted, provisional
values.description: Not accepted, provisional Not accepted, subject to confirmation.

values.name: Verification
values.description: Verification The message is transmitted to verify information.

values.name: Unsettled dispute
values.description: Unsettled dispute To report an unsettled dispute.
